overview_description.description: Science is a clinical-stage medical technology company focused on developing neural interface systems to address conditions such as vision loss, cognitive impairment, and motor dysfunction. The company integrates neural recording electronics, optogenetic stimulation, and software platforms to create brain-computer interface (BCI) solutions. Its product suite includes Axon neural probes, the SciFi headstage, and the Synapse communication protocol, which together form a modular platform for neural engineering applications. Science also develops implantable devices like PRIMA, a wireless photovoltaic stimulation array aimed at restoring vision in patients with retinal degenerative diseases.​

about_short_description.short_description: Science is a clinical-stage medical technology company that develops neuroengineering systems to address neurological and sensory disorders.

product.name: PRIMA Visual Prosthesis
product.description: An investigational brain-computer-interface visual prosthesis intended to restore useful vision for people with certain retinal degenerative conditions, including macular degeneration and retinitis pigmentosa.

product.name: Biohybrid
product.description: A neural-interface technology that connects the brain with living neurons to support research into brain-computer interfaces and neurological restoration.

product.name: Vessel
product.description: An investigational perfusion technology designed to support and extend the viability of biological tissues, organs, or related systems outside the body.

product.name: Ecosystem
product.description: A full-stack neural engineering platform combining neural recording electronics, probes, chips, software, and related systems for brain-computer-interface development.

product.name: Science Foundry — MEMS Production
product.description: A service providing MEMS process development and wafer fabrication for organizations developing microfabricated medical, neural, and research devices.

product.name: Science Foundry — Neural Engineering
product.description: A service that provides access to Science’s neural-engineering toolkit for developing and testing brain-computer-interface and neural-recording systems.
